newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria offers 40,000 tonnes of wheat for sale.
newsitem.headline: Syria offers 40,000 tonnes of wheat for sale.

text.p: Syria's General Establishment for Cereal Processing and Trade (GECPT) has offered 40,000 tonnes of hard durum amber wheat for sale, a company spokesman said on Tuesday.
He said March 18 was the final date for receiving bids and the results would be announced on March 19.
The wheat, from the 1996 crop, would be ready for shipment in May.
The GECPT said earlier on Tuesday it had sold 15,000 tonnes of wheat to Turkish companies from 50,000 tonnes originally offered for sale on March 4.
